description: Move a project to Recently deleted. It leaves every project list at once and can be restored for 30 days, with restore_project or from the person's projects page; after that it is deleted for good, with its saved versions, uploaded images and clips. Returns { name, purgeAt, restorable: true }, where purgeAt is when it will be deleted for good (epoch ms). Deleting for good before then is the person's own step on their projects page; no tool does it. Requires edit access — the owner, a workspace editor/admin/owner, or a direct-share editor; anyone else gets the opaque not-found. Deleting the last remaining project is allowed.
